name: Smoking Cigarettes
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject the fleeting and harmful vanities of the world, encouraging a transformation through the renewing of the mind to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2; Psalms 119:37). The imagery of fire and sparks from Job 41:19 reminds us of the potential dangers associated with burning substances, symbolizing the need for careful stewardship of our bodies. God is near to the brokenhearted and those who humbly seek Him (Psalms 34:18), offering strength to overcome temptation and harmful habits (Philippians 4:13). Ultimately, Galatians 6:7 warns that we will reap the consequences of our choices, urging believers to consider the spiritual and physical effects of smoking cigarettes.
